title: Verified queries, one SQL answer per common question on a governed metric

line.description: One line of plain text: no line break, no leading or trailing space.

metric.description: The MetricFlow metric the query answers, of role headline.

version.description: The metric's version, as its config.meta holds it.

owner.description: The metric's owner, as its config.meta holds it.

group_by.description: The grain: MetricFlow group-by names, also the SQL's columns.

where.description: The filter, in MetricFlow's where syntax, the SQL also applies.

sql.description: One select over the local build, returning the grain's columns and the metric's.
